sources.title: Kafka design
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Kafka：at-least-once 重播與副作用去重
related.titleEn: Kafka: at-least-once replay and side-effect deduplication
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：以每 partition 的 next offset 計算 lag，辨識消費進度不是跨 partition 全域序。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compute lag from each partition’s next offset and distinguish per-partition progress from global order. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 比較先做副作用再提交 offset 與相反順序的當機結果。
related.differenceEn: Compare crash outcomes when effects precede offset commits versus the reverse.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: offset 只在同一 partition 內排序；committed offset 通常表示下一筆要讀的位置。 教學基準：(120-100)+(80-65)+(50-50) = 35 total record lag；第二檢核：120-100 = 20 P0 lag。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
先處理後提交可重播，先提交後處理可遺失；Kafka 內部交易不自動涵蓋任意外部資料庫。 教學基準：5+7+3 = 15 correct unique effect；第二檢核：5+7+7+3 = 22 naive replay effect。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Offsets order records within one partition; a committed offset normally identifies the next record to consume. Teaching baseline: (120-100)+(80-65)+(50-50) = 35 total record lag; second check: 120-100 = 20 P0 lag. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Processing before commit allows replay; committing first risks loss. Kafka transactions do not automatically cover arbitrary external databases. Teaching baseline: 5+7+3 = 15 correct unique effect; second check: 5+7+7+3 = 22 naive replay effect. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Trace interleaved database updates and cache misses to identify stale fills.
